name: The Door That Would Not Break

evidence.text: Unique Item: The Door That Would Not Break; Availability: Unique; Effect and Burden: +2 AC; Ogryn only; counts as a Slab Shield and has no Speed penalty. If you do not move, up to two Small or Medium allies directly behind you have Full Cover. Once per long rest, when a weapon attack hits you, reduce that attack's damage to 0. Burden: it is enormous and impossible to conceal.
